g.text: Title: 4S Li-ion BMS - BQ76920 analog front end + protection FETs

g.desc: Title: 4S Li-ion BMS - BQ76920 analog front end + protection FETs

g.text: 4x LG HG2 18650 in series (16.8 V max), 22 A discharge / 4.5 A charge

g.desc: 4x LG HG2 18650 in series (16.8 V max), 22 A discharge / 4.5 A charge

g.text: Firmware: firmware/ (EKF SOC, protection, balancing) on the MCU at J3

g.desc: Firmware: firmware/ (EKF SOC, protection, balancing) on the MCU at J3

g.text: Rc = 43 ohm, Cc = 1 uF per cell (datasheet range 40-1k ohm / 0.1-10 uF).

g.desc: Rc = 43 ohm, Cc = 1 uF per cell (datasheet range 40-1k ohm / 0.1-10 uF).

g.text: Rc also sets the internal balancing current: 4.1 V / (2 x 43 + ~4) ohm = 45 mA.

g.desc: Rc also sets the internal balancing current: 4.1 V / (2 x 43 + ~4) ohm = 45 mA.

g.text: 4 cells on a BQ76920: VC4 is shorted to VC3 (datasheet Table 9-2).

g.desc: 4 cells on a BQ76920: VC4 is shorted to VC3 (datasheet Table 9-2).

g.text: BAT filter Rf = 100 ohm / Cf = 10 uF; REGSRC tied to BAT; REGOUT = 3.3 V for the MCU side

g.desc: BAT filter Rf = 100 ohm / Cf = 10 uF; REGSRC tied to BAT; REGOUT = 3.3 V for the MCU side

g.text: TVS clamps the inductive kick when a FET opens under load

g.desc: TVS clamps the inductive kick when a FET opens under load

g.text: 14-bit cell ADC (382 uV LSB), 16-bit coulomb counter (8.44 uV LSB),

g.desc: 14-bit cell ADC (382 uV LSB), 16-bit coulomb counter (8.44 uV LSB),

g.text: Q1/Q2: CSD18540Q5B, 60 V, 1.8 mOhm (0.9 W at 22 A). Back-to-back FETs: DSG blocks discharge,

g.desc: Q1/Q2: CSD18540Q5B, 60 V, 1.8 mOhm (0.9 W at 22 A). Back-to-back FETs: DSG blocks discharge,

g.text: CHG blocks charge; each body diode lets the other direction flow, so a tripped pack can

g.desc: CHG blocks charge; each body diode lets the other direction flow, so a tripped pack can

g.text: still be charged after an under-voltage trip or discharged after an over-voltage trip.

g.desc: still be charged after an under-voltage trip or discharged after an over-voltage trip.

g.text: 1 mOhm shunt: OCD 22.2 mV = 22 A, SCD 66.6 mV = 67 A, 8.4 mA resolution

g.desc: 1 mOhm shunt: OCD 22.2 mV = 22 A, SCD 66.6 mV = 67 A, 8.4 mA resolution

g.text: hardware OV / UV / OCD / SCD protection, internal cell balancing

g.desc: hardware OV / UV / OCD / SCD protection, internal cell balancing

g.text: TS1: NTC on the cells; a rising edge from BOOT wakes the AFE from SHIP mode

g.desc: TS1: NTC on the cells; a rising edge from BOOT wakes the AFE from SHIP mode

g.text: J3: 3.3 V, SDA, SCL, ALERT, BOOT, GND
